notes.title: Two and a Half Years in Development – XenoHaven Has Evolved!
notes.notes: [p align="justify"]Hello, pioneers! I'm the developer of the sandbox survival RPG [i]XenoHaven[/i].[/p][p align="justify"]Since our first trailer in February 2023, the game has been under development for over two and a half years, and we're excited to share what's changed.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]🔗 [i]XenoHaven[/i] Steam page:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461270/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p align="justify"]🔗 [url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1supqzHEbs] Watch the video here [/url][/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Over the past months, we've completely overhauled the art to make the world feel truly alien. From landscapes and biomes to creatures, every visual element has been polished to give players a stronger sense of being on another planet.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]Gameplay systems have also seen major updates:[/p][p align="justify"]● [b]Demon Servants:[/b] Recruit and raise these creatures to assist in base building, combat, and exploration. Customize their abilities, evolve them into different forms, or even enhance them with genes collected from alien wildlife.[/p][p align="justify"]● [b]Gene System:[/b] Extract and apply genes to Demon Servants or even yourself, allowing attribute and skill changes while deepening system interconnections.[/p][p align="justify"]● [b]Dungeon System:[/b] Explore underground areas on any map, battle monsters, and collect rare gear and materials. Bosses drop unique weapons, from soul-summoning staves to energy-infused swords, making progression and combat more rewarding.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]We've also refined economy and crafting systems, allowing you to build production lines, trade with merchants, farm food, and run restaurants to maximize resources and strategy.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]If you haven't yet, wishlist [i]XenoHaven[/i] on Steam to stay updated on our upcoming free demo and future tests.[/p][p align="justify"]Your feedback is invaluable to us as we continue to improve and expand the game.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]We can't wait for you to experience the world we've been building—thank you for your support![/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Follow our community to get the latest information![/b][/h3][p align="justify"]💬[b]Discord:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/p8jHhK7QH2"]https://discord.gg/p8jHhK7QH2[/url][/p][p align="justify"]🔗[b]X: [/b][url="https://x.com/XenoHaven01"]https://x.com/XenoHaven01[/url][/p][p align="justify"]🔗[b]Bluesky: [/b][url="https://bsky.app/profile/xenohaven.bsky.social"]https://bsky.app/profile/xenohaven.bsky.social[/url][/p][p align="justify"][/p]

notes.title: Took a Month Off… and Ended Up Adding a Dungeon Loot System！
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p align="justify"]I’m the developer of [b]XenoHaven[/b], a sandbox survival RPG currently in development. If you’re a fan of sandbox survival experiences, please consider [b]adding the game to your Wishlist[/b]—your support really helps us a lot! 💖[/p][p align="justify"][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461270/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p align="justify"]It’s been about a month since our last dev log update. During this time, besides continuing to optimize the game and fix bugs, we’ve also been working on implementing some new ideas. You can [url="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1uPHYzLEDf/"] [b]watch the video here [/b] [/url], or scroll down for screenshots and details. [/p][p][/p][h2][b]🕹️ New Feature: Dungeon Exploration[/b][/h2][p align="justify"]Previously, we talked about the new [b]Demon Servants System[/b], which focused on strengthening your Demon Servants. However, one problem remained: while Demon Servants are powerful, the player character often feels fragile—many times, your Demon Servants are still fighting even after you’re already dead.[/p][p align="justify"]To address this, we wanted players themselves to grow stronger through progression. That’s why we decided to add [b]dungeon exploration[/b]![/p][p]● You can now [b]craft and place staircases[/b] to open passages leading underground.[/p][p]● Some regions on the world map may also generate staircases that take you into underground zones of that biome.[/p][p]● Inside dungeons, you can mine resources with your pickaxe, fight monsters for materials, and even challenge dungeon bosses.[/p][p align="justify"]Defeating bosses rewards you with [b]random-quality accessories[/b] that improve your stats or grant special ability effects.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559598/7d52e8e7f69eab5f043be4011d6ce6755771f1d9.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]💍 Accessory System[/b][/h2][p align="justify"]Accessories come in two categories: [b]special accessories[/b] (1 slot) and [b]general accessories[/b] (4 slots).[/p][p]● Special accessories offer unique power boosts.[/p][p]● General accessories include a wide range of buffs and effects.[/p][p align="justify"]Accessories can be obtained from:[/p][p]● Dungeon boss drops[/p][p]● Treasure chests in the wild[/p][p]● [b]Bio-Lab genetic patches[/b], which can also be equipped in general accessory slots.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559598/167fc6654396bc75a420e7203494f2307028bb68.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]🌍 New Biomes & Map Updates[/b][/h2][p align="justify"]Open the map and you’ll notice some changes! We’ve added more [b]biome environments[/b], including:[/p][p]● The eerie and sinister [b]Demon Forest[/b][/p][p]● The desolate and dangerous [b]Volcano[/b] biome[/p][p align="justify"]We also refined the way [b]map tiles[/b] represent different features:[/p][p]● Desert tiles with houses indicate a [b]village[/b][/p][p]● Desert tiles with flags indicate [b]bandit/rebel camps[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559598/2f7587cd9c99b523f0bfc042aed5aa1c93fbfb2b.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]🎨 UI Improvements[/b][/h2][p align="justify"]Some of you may also notice slight changes in the UI. This is an area where we’ve received lots of feedback, and while it’s impossible to satisfy everyone’s preferences, we’ll continue to refine the interface step by step. Please keep sharing your thoughts with us—we really value your input![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559598/e42384cc94cf2fe206339fe404f823650e776756.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]That’s all for this dev log![/p][p align="justify"]If you’re interested in [b]XenoHaven[/b], don’t forget to [b]add it to your Wishlist[/b]. And if you have any feedback or ideas, feel free to join our community and share your thoughts.[/p][p align="justify"]Thanks again for your support—we’ll see you in the next update! 👋[/p][h3][b]Follow our community to get the latest information![/b][/h3][p align="justify"]💬[b]Discord:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/p8jHhK7QH2"]https://discord.gg/p8jHhK7QH2[/url][/p][p align="justify"]🔗[b]X: [/b][url="https://x.com/XenoHaven01"]https://x.com/XenoHaven01[/url][/p][p align="justify"]🔗[b]Bluesky: [/b][url="https://bsky.app/profile/xenohaven.bsky.social"]https://bsky.app/profile/xenohaven.bsky.social[/url][/p][p align="justify"][/p]

notes.title: 🧬 I created Demon Servants to fight off alien bugs 💪
notes.notes: [p]Hey Pioneers![/p][p]We're just [b]2 days away[/b] from the second PlayTest of our alien-world sandbox survival game [b]XenoHaven[/b]![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461270/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]🎥 Want a quick visual tour of what's changed? Check out the [url="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1gygJznEzb"] video here [/url][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🌍 From "Too Earth-like" to Truly Alien[/b][/h3][p]After our first PlayTest, we heard a lot of helpful feedback—most of it summed up with one phrase:[i] "It's fine, but nothing stands out."[/i][/p][p]Sure, we had survival, exploration, building, farming, tech progression, gene engineering… but none of these systems felt deep or unique enough to define the game. Also, despite the alien setting, bunnies, boars, and apple trees made players feel like they were still on Earth. That wasn't the vibe we were going for.[/p][p]So we've overhauled it—new terrain, minerals, vegetation, and wildlife to make the world feel [b]truly off-world[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559598/f3630d80b64b3a6aa2a72cafc2d46b2cb5f3750b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🧪 The Demon Servant System: Grow Your Own Guardian[/b][/h3][p]After internal debates and brainstorming, our team decided to lean hard into [b]creature raising[/b] as a core feature—and fully integrate it with the rest of the game systems.[/p][p]That's where the [b]Demon Servants[/b] come in.[/p][p]You'll raise and evolve them from scratch. Feed them with crafted rations—each tier unlocked via your tech tree. Customize them through gene lab experiments.[/p][p]Swap heads (literally), modify traits, and create combat-ready creatures with unique skills and personality quirks. They can work at your base, or follow you into the wild as your personal battle companion—think of them as your alien "Guards".[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559598/d64188063828f134474541ea2686fdf1016ca707.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🧪 We're still refining the system and will share a deep-dive video soon. In the meantime, join us on July 24th for the second PlayTest and let us know what you think![/b][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Follow our community to get the latest information![/b][/h3][p]💬[b]Discord:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/p8jHhK7QH2"]https://discord.gg/p8jHhK7QH2[/url][/p][p]🔗[b]X: [/b][url="https://x.com/XenoHaven01"]https://x.com/XenoHaven01[/url][/p][p]🔗[b]Bluesky: [/b][url="https://bsky.app/profile/xenohaven.bsky.social"]https://bsky.app/profile/xenohaven.bsky.social[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: XenoHaven - Developer Q&A
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Since the release of the trailer for our sandbox survival building game XenoHaven, we’ve received a lot of positive feedback from players. 
At the same time, many players have shared their thoughts and questions in the comments. To address some of the most common concerns, we’ve decided to release a Developer Q&A session.

1️⃣ Concerns About Plagiarism
The developer of XenoHaven is a passionate fan of RimWorld and this genre as a whole. The vision for this game has always been to create an open-world survival-building experience with an RPG perspective, where players take on the role of a colonist landing on an alien planet. 🚀

After playing Keplerth, we found valuable insights into how RimWorld’s mechanics could be reinterpreted in an RPG format—huge respect to our amazing predecessors! 🙌 Beyond Keplerth, we’ve also drawn inspiration from other excellent games such as CryoFall and Necesse. However, we are committed to developing unique features that define XenoHaven.

For example, when faced with the challenges of surviving on an alien planet, should the only solution be defeating the final boss and building a massive rocket to escape? Or are there alternative possibilities? 🤔 Perhaps you could find a pre-built rocket and pay an exorbitant fee for a ticket out. These choices excite us, and they set us apart in terms of game design themes. We’d love to hear more of your creative ideas! 💡

2️⃣ Art Design Concerns
We sincerely apologize 🙇 for any overly similar art elements. Some placeholder assets were used during development, and we are in the process of replacing them step by step. 🔄 We’ll conduct thorough reviews to ensure all elements are fully replaced, and we’ll also refine the UI based on player feedback. 🎨

3️⃣ Current Development Progress
The core framework of the game has been built, and we’ve validated most of the key mechanics. The next phase involves refining the game and adding more content. We are committed to taking steady, well-planned steps forward. 🏗️ Our long-term development and update plans will be shared at the right time.Right now, our top priority is testing the core gameplay of the current version. We sincerely invite everyone to participate in our testing and share your feedback—whether it’s encouragement 🌟 or constructive criticism ⚠️, we take it all seriously.
💬 Please leave your thoughts in the comments! The most popular ideas might even be implemented in the game—who knows, you might even get an in-game statue in your honor! 🗿✨

4️⃣ Pet System
The pet system will be further expanded! 🐾 Players will be able to capture all animals on the planet, and these pets will not only assist in combat ⚔️ but can also be used as mounts 🏇.

5️⃣ Future Development Plans
We aim to introduce more engaging content that enhances the game’s uniqueness and depth. We’ll continue sharing development progress and discussing new features with our players. 📢A major focus will be expanding the multi-ending design. We believe that a world shouldn’t have just one solution—combat is not the only option. We plan to enrich the gameplay to allow players to approach survival in different ways. 🌎
For example:
[list]
[*] Instead of building a rocket, why not simply buy a ticket on an existing one? 🎫
[*] You could submit to the alien insectoid species and become their servant. 👀
[*] Through careful management, you could develop your colony into a prosperous hub, eventually earning recognition from the Empire and becoming the governor of an official colony in the “500 Worlds”. 🏛️
[/list]
If you have your own ideas for alternate endings, we’d love to hear them in the community! 📝
                                                                                                                                          
6️⃣ Mod Support & Multiplayer System
We value modding greatly. 🔧 A game truly thrives when the community actively contributes to its design and expands it with mods, so we plan to enable mod support appropriately.Survival-building games are never meant to be played alone, which is why multiplayer is a key development focus moving forward. We will begin testing this feature as soon as possible. 🌐
Additionally, we’re planning to organize more community events. 🥳 Join our official community to become a part of the Alien Settlement Administration! 🏡

💬Discord: https://discord.gg/p8jHhK7QH2
